commits.author: Ruban
commits.message:
DTSCCI-5447: Preserve Bearer prefix when calling auth provider /details (#3496)

After PR #3493, S2sAuthFilter still returned 401 on prod callbacks
because extractBearerToken stripped the "Bearer " prefix before calling
getServiceName(token). The Feign client forwards that string as the
Authorization header on GET /details, and rpe-service-auth-provider
rejected it as "Invalid authorization header".

Match the library's stock ServiceAuthFilter, which always passes a
"Bearer <token>" string to getServiceName(). Prepend "Bearer " when
the incoming header is missing it.

Chart bumped 4.1.60 -> 4.1.61.

commits.author: Ruban
commits.message:
DTSCCI-5447: Hotfix - drop redundant S2S validate() call breaking callbacks in prod (#3493)

* DTSCC-5388: Hotfix - drop redundant validate() call breaking S2S auth

The custom S2sAuthFilter was calling authTokenValidator.validate(token)
before getServiceName(token). validate(token) (no roles overload) hits
the auth provider's /authorisation-check?role= endpoint which no longer
exists on the Spring Boot 3 rpe-service-auth-provider, returning 404.

CCD callbacks (e.g. /cases/callbacks/about-to-submit) started failing
with 401 in prod after IDAM_S2S_AUTH_SERVICES_ALLOWED was set in
abeb0254e, which activated the previously short-circuited filter path.

getServiceName(token) already throws InvalidTokenException for invalid
tokens via the /details endpoint, matching the library's stock
ServiceAuthFilter behaviour.

* DTSCC-5388: Suppress Tomcat 10.1.52 CVEs blocking hotfix

CVE-2026-41293, -43512, -43513, -43515 all fixed in Tomcat 10.1.55.
Suppress to unblock the S2S callback hotfix; follow-up needed to bump
Spring Boot (or Tomcat directly) once a release containing 10.1.55 is
available.
